decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, as as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority (before the building(s) is/are occupied/used.

Condition : 3 - Full details, with samples, of all materials to be used on the dormer, garage and side extension shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority in writing before any work on the site is commenced.  The development shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance eith the details thus

Condition : 4 - Details of a brick stringcourse to the side elevation shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority in writing before any work on the site is commenced.  The development shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with the details thus approved.
description: Demolition of existing garage and erection of detached garage and erection of two storey side and single storey rear extension to dwellinghouse.
